name: Auto Driver Sevalo
brief: The "Auto Driver Sevalo" scheme is implemented by the Transport Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh.
briefFull: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹15,000 per annum to eligible self-owned Auto Rickshaw, Motor Cab and Maxi Cab drivers in Andhra Pradesh. The assistance is intended to support expenditure towards vehicle insurance, fitness certificates, repairs and other related requirements.
details:
The "Auto Driver Sevalo" scheme is implemented by the Transport Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh. Under the scheme, eligible drivers who own an Auto Rickshaw, Motor Cab or Maxi Cab receive financial assistance of ₹15,000 per annum to meet vehicle-related expenses.
The Transport Department provides vehicle and owner details, including the vehicle registration number, owner's name, address, contact number and registration date, for verification and processing. The GSWS Department provides IT support for application submission and registration of new beneficiaries.
New beneficiaries must visit their nearest Grama Sachivalayam or Ward Sachivalayam and approach the Digital Assistant or Data Processing Secretary to submit the Auto Driver Sevalo New Application (2025). The application process is free of cost.
The scheme implementation process includes verification of beneficiary and vehicle details, preparation of final eligible and ineligible lists, and submission of corporation-wise eligible beneficiary lists along with financial assistance details to the Transport Department. Financial assistance is disbursed through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB) mode.
> **Note:** Applicants must satisfy the prescribed vehicle ownership, driving licence, income, landholding and other household eligibility conditions. Only one eligible vehicle per household is permitted under the scheme.
benefits:
- Annual financial assistance of ₹15,000 to eligible self-owned Auto Rickshaw, Motor Cab and Maxi Cab drivers.
- Financial support towards vehicle insurance, fitness certificates, repairs and other related expenses.
- Application submission through the nearest Grama Sachivalayam or Ward Sachivalayam.
- Free-of-cost application submission for new beneficiaries.
- Verification and preparation of eligible and ineligible beneficiary lists.
- Disbursement of financial assistance through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB) mode.
eligibility:
> **Applicants must satisfy the following eligibility conditions:**

1. **Vehicle ownership:** The applicant must own an Auto Rickshaw, Motor Cab or Maxi Cab that meets the prescribed vehicle eligibility requirements. The vehicle must be active as on the applicable eligibility cut-off date.1. **Driving licence:** The applicant or one of the household members must possess a valid driving licence issued in Andhra Pradesh for an Auto Rickshaw or Light Motor Vehicle, as applicable, and valid as on the prescribed cut-off date.1. **Vehicle registration:** The vehicle must be registered in Andhra Pradesh.1. **Vehicle documents:** The vehicle must have a valid Registration Certificate (RC), fitness certificate and applicable tax payments. Auto Rickshaws are exempted from the fitness certificate requirement for the specified year only, but must obtain the certificate within one month.1. **Vehicle category:** Only passenger vehicles, namely Auto Rickshaws, Motor Cabs and Maxi Cabs, are eligible. Goods vehicles are not eligible.1. **Income limit:** The household's monthly income must not exceed ₹10,000 in rural areas and ₹12,000 in urban areas.1. **Rice card:** At least one member of the household must possess a rice card.1. **Landholding:** Total landholding must be less than 3 acres of wetland or 10 acres of dry land or combined wet and dry land, as prescribed under the scheme.1. **Four-wheeler ownership:** The household must not own a four-wheeler, except for vehicles specifically exempted under the scheme, such as taxis, tractors and autos.1. **Electricity consumption:** Average annual electricity consumption must be less than 300 units per month.1. **Municipal property:** The household must not own municipal property measuring 1,000 square feet or more.1. **Government employment or pension:** If any household member is employed in Central or State Government service or a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), or receives a government pension after retirement, the household is generally ineligible. Exceptions apply to sanitation workers and employees earning less than ₹10,000 per month in rural areas or ₹12,000 per month in urban areas, as specified in the scheme conditions.1. **Income tax:** If any household member pays income tax, the household is ineligible.1. **One vehicle per household:** Only one eligible vehicle per household is permitted under the scheme.1. **Leased or rented vehicles:** Vehicles leased or rented to organisations, including government organisations, are not eligible.1. **Pending dues or challans:** The vehicle must not have any pending dues or traffic challans.
howToApply:
[Offline]
> **The application process for new beneficiaries is carried out through the Grama Sachivalayam or Ward Sachivalayam.**

- **Visit the Sachivalayam:** Visit the nearest Grama Sachivalayam or Ward Sachivalayam in your area.- **Contact the designated official:** Approach the Digital Assistant or Data Processing Secretary available at the Sachivalayam.- **Submit a new application:** Request the official to submit the Auto Driver Sevalo New Application  through the designated online system.- **Provide the required details:** Provide the required applicant, household and vehicle details, along with any information or documents requested by the official.- **Complete the application:** The designated official will assist with entering the required information and submitting the application through the online system.- **Application fee:** The application process is free of cost. No fee is required to submit the application.- **Verification and eligibility:** The submitted details are subject to verification against the scheme's eligibility criteria, including vehicle ownership, registration, driving licence and household eligibility conditions.- **Check application status:** Visit the [Auto Driver Sevalo Application Status Portal](https://bm-sgsw.ap.gov.in/BM/Applnstatus) to check the application status.- **Finalisation of beneficiary lists:** The concerned authorities prepare the final eligible and ineligible beneficiary lists after verification. Corporation-wise details of eligible beneficiaries and their financial assistance are shared with the Transport Department.- **Receive financial assistance:** Eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of ₹15,000 per annum through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB) mode, subject to final verification and approval.
> **NOTE:** The supplied website identifies the application status portal and the process for submitting new applications through the Sachivalayam. The detailed process for existing beneficiaries should be confirmed from the relevant website section or operational guidelines before publication.
documentsRequired:
**The following information and documents may be required for verification, subject to the official application form and operational guidelines:**

- **Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC):** Proof of registration of the Auto Rickshaw, Motor Cab or Maxi Cab in Andhra Pradesh.- **Driving license:** A valid driving license for an Auto Rickshaw or Light Motor Vehicle, as applicable.- **Fitness certificate:** A valid fitness certificate, wherever applicable under the scheme.- **Vehicle tax details:** Proof of applicable vehicle tax payments for Motor Cabs and Maxi Cabs.- **Vehicle insurance details:** Information relating to vehicle insurance, as required by the scheme.- **Rice card:** Proof that at least one household member possesses a rice card.- **Applicant and household details:** Name, address, contact number, income details and other information required for eligibility verification.- **Bank account details:** Details required for disbursement of financial assistance through the APB mode, as prescribed by the department.- **Additional verification records:** Landholding, electricity consumption, property ownership, employment, pension and income tax information, wherever required for determining eligibility.

faqs.q: What is the Auto Driver Sevalo scheme?
faqs.a: The Auto Driver Sevalo scheme provides annual financial assistance of ₹15,000 to eligible self-owned Auto Rickshaw, Motor Cab and Maxi Cab drivers in Andhra Pradesh to support vehicle-related expenses.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: Owners of eligible Auto Rickshaws, Motor Cabs and Maxi Cabs registered in Andhra Pradesh can apply, subject to the prescribed vehicle, driving licence, income and household eligibility conditions.

faqs.q: Where can an applicant submit a new application?
faqs.a: Applicants can visit their nearest Grama Sachivalayam or Ward Sachivalayam to submit a new application.

faqs.q: Who can assist with submitting the application?
faqs.a: The Digital Assistant or Data Processing Secretary at the concerned Sachivalayam can assist with submitting the Auto Driver Sevalo New Application.
No. The application process is free of cost.

faqs.q: What is the prescribed household income limit?
faqs.a: The monthly household income must not exceed ₹10,000 in rural areas and ₹12,000 in urban areas.

faqs.q: Can more than one vehicle be covered under the scheme in a household?
faqs.a: No. Only one eligible vehicle per household is permitted under the scheme.

faqs.q: What are the main eligibility conditions apart from vehicle ownership?
faqs.a: At least one household member must possess a rice card. The applicant must also satisfy the prescribed driving licence, landholding, electricity consumption, property ownership and other household eligibility conditions.

faqs.q: How can an applicant check the application status?
faqs.a: Applicants can visit the [Auto Driver Sevalo Application Status Portal](https://bm-sgsw.ap.gov.in/BM/Applnstatus) to check their application status.

faqs.q: How is financial assistance disbursed under the scheme?
faqs.a: Eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of ₹15,000 per annum through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB) mode, subject to verification and approval.
